label: Any two beings, each having every pure perfection and only pure perfections among its real…
paraphrase: Any two beings, each having every pure perfection and only pure perfections among its real determinations, are one and the same being. Ranges over all beings; encodes SCG I.42 [3]'s claim that several absolutely perfect gods, lacking no perfection and with no admixture of imperfection, cannot be several.
